description: This file defines a class CBFTransformer that transforms LiteLLM usage data into CloudZero Billing Format (CBF). It includes methods for data filtering, record creation, and date parsing, utilizing external modules for data handling and resource name generation.

classes.name: CBFTransformer
classes.description: A class to transform LiteLLM usage data into CloudZero Billing Format (CBF).

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CBFTransformer with a CZRNGenerator instance.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a DataFrame of LiteLLM data into CBF format, filtering out records with zero successful requests or invalid CZRNs, and returns a new DataFrame.

methods.name: _create_cbf_record
methods.description: Creates a single CBF record from a row of LiteLLM data, including resource identification, dimensions, and tags.

methods.name: _parse_date
methods.description: Parses date strings from daily spend tables into datetime objects.
